articles.title_en: The Rise of the Engineer: Inventing the Professional Inventor During the Industrial Revolution
articles.title_cn: 工程师的崛起：工业革命期间职业发明家的发明
articles.abstract_en: How did the Industrial Revolution generate sustained economic growth? One hypothesis is that the innovation system changed. This paper provides direct quantitative evidence documenting this fundamental change in the innovation system: the emergence of a new type of inventor, the professional engineer. Using rich patent, biographical and other data, I document the emergence of the engineering profession starting in the late eighteenth century and show that engineers differed from older types of inventors in important ways. These findings improve our understanding of the Industrial Revolution and provide perspective for evaluating more recent changes in the innovation system.
articles.abstract_cn: 工业革命如何产生持续的经济增长？一种假说是创新体系发生了变化。本文提供了直接的定量证据，记录了创新体系中的这一根本性变化：一种新型发明家——职业工程师的出现。利用丰富的专利、传记及其他数据，我记录了始于十八世纪末的工程职业的兴起，并表明工程师在重要方面与更早类型的发明家有所不同。这些发现增进了我们对工业革命的理解，并为评估创新体系中更近期的变化提供了视角。

articles.title_en: The Welfare Effects of Supply and Demand Frictions in a Dynamic Pricing Game
articles.title_cn: 动态定价博弈中供给与需求摩擦的福利效应
articles.abstract_en: We propose a dynamic oligopoly pricing model, in which consumers’ choices exhibit inertia and firms face costly price adjustments. The primitives of the model are estimated using scanner data from the UK butter and margarine industry. We evaluate the effects of frictions on price dynamics, profits and consumer welfare. We find that price adjustment costs are substantial and represent between 24%–34% of net margins. Our model predicts that the absence of these costs reduces persistence in prices, increases firms’ profits, but has little effect on consumer surplus. The effects of consumer inertia on prices are much more pronounced than when firms cannot adjust prices freely.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一个动态寡头定价模型，其中消费者选择表现出惯性，企业面临昂贵的价格调整。模型的原始参数使用英国黄油和人造黄油行业的扫描数据进行估计。我们评估了摩擦对价格动态、利润和消费者福利的影响。我们发现价格调整成本是显著的，占净边际的24%至34%。我们的模型预测，缺乏这些成本会降低价格的持续性，增加企业利润，但对消费者剩余影响甚微。消费者惯性对价格的影响比企业无法自由调整价格时更为显著。

articles.title_en: Faith and Assimilation: Italian Immigrants in the US
articles.title_cn: 信仰与同化：美国的意大利移民
articles.abstract_en: We study the effects of ethnic religious organisations on immigrant assimilation, assembling novel data on Italian Catholic churches across US counties between 1890 and 1920. Exploiting variation in the timing of church entry, we find that Italian churches reduced social and economic assimilation along dimensions that require more inter-group interactions, but had null or positive effects on outcomes for which cross-group coordination is less important. We provide evidence that coordination within the Italian community and natives' backlash are plausible pathways for our results. We also document that churches increased literacy and English-speaking ability of immigrant children.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了族裔宗教组织对移民同化的影响，汇编了1890年至1920年间美国各县意大利天主教堂的新数据。利用教堂建立时间的变化，我们发现意大利教堂减少了需要更多群体间互动的维度上的社会和经济同化，但对跨群体协调不那么重要的结果则没有影响或产生积极影响。我们提供的证据表明，意大利社区内部的协调和本土人的反弹是我们结果的合理路径。我们还记录了教堂提高了移民儿童的识字率和英语口语能力。

articles.title_en: From Connections to Merit: Anti-Corruption Reform and Occupational Mobility in China's Civil Service
articles.title_cn: 从关系到功绩：中国的反腐败改革与公务员职业流动性
articles.abstract_en: In China, employment in the civil service is perceived as a primary path to leadership roles in government. This paper examines the role of family background in shaping the choice to enter the civil service and investigates the impact of the 2012 anti-corruption campaign on this process. We find that college graduates with cadre parents are more likely to work as a civil servant. However, using a difference-in-differences approach, we show an 18% decline in this occupational persistence post-campaign. Evidence suggests that reduced use of parental social networks may drive this change. Furthermore, the campaign appears to have improved civil servants’ quality.
articles.abstract_cn: 在中国，公务员职业被视为通往政府领导岗位的主要途径。本文考察了家庭背景在塑造进入公务员职业选择中的作用，并研究了2012年反腐败运动对这一过程的影响。我们发现，有干部父母的大学毕业生更有可能成为公务员。然而，使用双重差分方法，我们显示该运动后这种职业持续性下降了18%。证据表明，父母社会网络使用的减少可能是这一变化的原因。此外，该运动似乎提高了公务员的质量。

articles.title_en: Reducing Bias Among Health Care Providers: Experimental Evidence from Tanzania, Burkina Faso and Pakistan
articles.title_cn: 减少医疗服务提供者中的偏见：来自坦桑尼亚、布基纳法索和巴基斯坦的实验证据
articles.abstract_en: Bias among health care providers can lead to poor-quality care and poor health outcomes, and it can exacerbate disparities. We use a randomised controlled trial to evaluate an intervention to reduce family planning provider bias towards young women in 227 clinics in Tanzania, Burkina Faso and Pakistan. The intervention educated providers about bias towards young women, facilitated communication about bias with other providers and offered non-financial public awards to clinics with the least biased care. After twelve months, the intervention led to less biased attitudes and beliefs among providers and more comprehensive counselling. Clients also perceived better treatment at intervention clinics compared to control clinics. Despite reductions in reported bias, we find mixed evidence regarding changes in method dispensing.
articles.abstract_cn: 医疗服务提供者中的偏见可能导致低质量的护理和不良的健康结果，并可能加剧不平等。我们使用随机对照试验来评估一项干预措施，旨在减少坦桑尼亚、布基纳法索和巴基斯坦227家诊所中计划生育服务提供者对年轻女性的偏见。该干预措施教育提供者关于对年轻女性偏见的知识，促进提供者之间关于偏见的沟通，并向护理偏见最少的诊所提供非经济性公共奖励。十二个月后，该干预措施导致提供者的偏见态度和信念减少，咨询更加全面。与对照诊所相比，干预诊所的客户也感受到更好的待遇。尽管报告中的偏见有所减少，但我们在方法分发变化方面发现了混合证据。

articles.title_en: Scared Straight or Scared to Death? Fatalism in Response to Disease Risks
articles.title_cn: 吓直了还是吓死了？面对疾病风险的宿命论
articles.abstract_en: This paper shows that responses to disease risks can be ‘fatalistic’: higher risk beliefs can lead to more risk-taking rather than less. Intuitively, this can occur because high risk beliefs raise not only the chance of contracting the disease (which raises the marginal cost of risk-taking), but also the perceived chance that you are already infected (which lowers the marginal cost). I test for fatalism by randomly providing information about the true (low) average risk of HIV transmission in Malawi. Consistent with rational fatalism, the treatment causes sexual activity to rise slightly on average, but decline sharply for people with high initial risk beliefs—especially those with high baseline levels of sexual activity.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文表明，对疾病风险的反应可能是“宿命论的”：更高的风险信念可能导致更多的冒险行为，而非更少。直观上，这可能发生是因为高风险信念不仅提高了感染疾病的可能性（这增加了冒险的边际成本），也提高了你已感染的感知可能性（这降低了边际成本）。我通过随机提供马拉维HIV传播的真实（低）平均风险信息来检验宿命论。与理性宿命论一致，该处理导致性活动平均略有上升，但对于初始风险信念高的人群——尤其是基线性活动水平高的人群——性活动急剧下降。

articles.title_en: Managerial Leadership, Truth-Telling, and Efficient Coordination
articles.title_cn: 管理领导力、讲真话与高效协调
articles.abstract_en: We study the manager-agent game, a novel coordination game played between a manager and two agents. Unlike commonly studied coordination games, the manager-agent game stresses asymmetric information (agents know the state of the world, but managers do not) and asymmetric payoffs (for all states of the world, agents have opposing preferences over outcomes). Efficient coordination requires coordinating agents’ actions and utilising their private information. We vary how agents’ actions are chosen (managerial control versus delegation), the mode of communication (none, structured communication or free-form chat) and the channels of communication (i.e., who can communicate with each other). Achieving coordination per se is not challenging, but, averaging across all states of the world, total surplus only surpasses the safe outcome when managerial control is combined with three-way free-form chat. Unlike weak-link games, advice from managers to agents does not increase total surplus. The combination of managerial control and free-form chat works because, under these conditions, agents rarely lie about their private information. Our results suggest that common findings from the experimental literature on lying are not robust to changes in the mode of communication.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了管理者-代理人博弈，这是一种在管理者和两个代理人之间进行的新型协调博弈。与通常研究的协调博弈不同，管理者-代理人博弈强调信息不对称（代理人知道世界状态，而管理者不知道）和收益不对称（对于所有世界状态，代理人对结果有相反的偏好）。高效协调需要协调代理人的行动并利用他们的私人信息。我们改变了代理人行动的选择方式（管理控制与授权）、沟通模式（无沟通、结构化沟通或自由聊天）以及沟通渠道（即谁可以与谁沟通）。实现协调本身并不困难，但平均而言，在所有世界状态下，只有当管理控制与三方自由聊天相结合时，总剩余才超过安全结果。与弱链接博弈不同，管理者向代理人提供的建议并不会增加总剩余。管理控制与自由聊天的结合之所以有效，是因为在这些条件下，代理人很少对其私人信息撒谎。我们的结果表明，实验文献中关于撒谎的常见发现在沟通模式变化下并不稳健。

articles.title_cn: 服务离岸外包与出口经验
articles.abstract_en: Service inputs significantly influence export costs and firm internationalisation. A new dataset on French firms’ participation in global value chains reveals that experienced exporters are more likely to source services at destination and within their group. We rationalise these facts in a model where firms are initially uncertain about their export profitability and learn it while selling abroad. The effect is amplified in uncertain markets and in the presence of frictions to domestic sourcing. Offshoring firms, in turn, exhibit reduced volatility and are less likely to exit foreign markets. Our empirical findings strongly support these theoretical predictions.
articles.abstract_cn: 服务投入显著影响出口成本和企业国际化。一项关于法国企业参与全球价值链的新数据集显示，有经验的出口商更倾向于在目的地和集团内部采购服务。我们在一个模型中合理化这些事实，该模型假设企业最初对其出口盈利能力不确定，并在海外销售过程中学习。这种效应在不确定市场以及国内采购存在摩擦的情况下被放大。反过来，离岸外包企业表现出较低的波动性，并且更不可能退出外国市场。我们的实证发现强烈支持这些理论预测。

articles.title_en: Revenue Persistence and Public Service Delivery
articles.title_cn: 收入持久性与公共服务提供
articles.abstract_en: I exploit unusual policy variation in Indonesia to examine how local responses to intergovernmental grants depend on their persistence. A national reform generated permanent increases in the general grant that were larger for less densely populated districts, while hydrocarbon-rich districts experienced transitory shocks to shared resource revenue. Public service delivery strongly responded to the permanent shock, but not to the transitory shocks, consistent with districts providing lumpy public services as a function of lifetime fiscal resources. The timing and composition of expenditure responses are consistent with this mechanism. The results suggest that the underwhelming effects of natural resource revenue found in previous studies could be due, in part, to forward-looking behaviour by local governments.
articles.abstract_cn: 我利用印度尼西亚不寻常的政策变化来考察地方政府对政府间转移支付的响应如何取决于其持久性。一项全国性改革带来了普通拨款永久性增加，且对人口密度较低的区增加幅度更大，而富含碳氢化合物的区则经历了共享资源收入的暂时性冲击。公共服务提供对永久性冲击反应强烈，但对暂时性冲击没有反应，这与各区根据终身财政资源提供块状公共服务的行为一致。支出反应的时间和构成与该机制相符。结果表明，先前研究中发现的自然资源收入效果不佳可能部分归因于地方政府的向前看行为。

articles.title_en: The Power of the Pill: Evidence from Oral Contraceptive Sales
articles.title_cn: 药丸的力量：来自口服避孕药销售的证据
articles.abstract_en: The introduction of oral contraception (‘the pill’) was a watershed in fertility control. Yet, the pill’s impact on childbearing has been hard to establish due to limited data. I exploit rich data on pill sales across markets and time to characterise how Swedish teens’ access to pharmacies shaped pill sales and fertility after the pill’s introduction. Pill sales are highly sensitive to pharmacy access, and teen fertility responds strongly to pill sales. The unique data establish an important link in the causal chain from pill access to women’s fertility. Estimated fertility responses to the pill could explain the halving of teen births after the pill’s introduction, a finding that is robust to accounting for trends in female education, abortion provision and other factors.
articles.abstract_cn: 口服避孕药（“药丸”）的引入是生育控制的一个分水岭。然而，由于数据有限，药丸对生育的影响难以确定。我利用跨市场和时间的丰富药丸销售数据，来刻画瑞典青少年获取药房的途径如何在药丸引入后影响药丸销售和生育率。药丸销售对药房可及性高度敏感，青少年生育率对药丸销售反应强烈。独特的数据确立了从药丸获取到女性生育因果链中的一个重要环节。估计的生育反应可以解释药丸引入后青少年生育率减半的现象，这一发现在考虑女性教育趋势、堕胎提供及其他因素后依然稳健。

articles.title_en: Yellow Pages: Information, connections and firm performance
articles.title_cn: 黄页：信息、联系与企业绩效
articles.abstract_en: We study the impact of a low-cost intervention to reduce information frictions in rural markets by randomly assigning small and medium enterprises in Tanzania to be listed in a telephone directory. The listed firms expand their communication networks, increase sales and make greater use of mobile money, with positive spillovers to firms in the same village. Estimated effects are larger and more statistically precise for firms that are more productive at baseline, consistent with consumers seeking out better firms when search costs fall. We find no evidence of negative between-village spillovers on unlisted firms.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了一项低成本干预措施对减少农村市场信息摩擦的影响，通过随机分配坦桑尼亚的中小企业列入电话目录。被列入目录的企业扩大了其通信网络，增加了销售额，并更多地使用移动货币，对同一村庄的企业产生了正向溢出效应。对于基线时生产率更高的企业，估计效应更大且统计上更精确，这与消费者在搜索成本下降时寻找更好企业的行为一致。我们没有发现对未列入目录的企业存在村庄间负向溢出效应的证据。

articles.title_en: A Comment on ‘Buyers' Miscoordination, Entry and Downstream Competition’
articles.title_cn: 对《买方不协调、进入与下游竞争》一文的评论
articles.abstract_en: Fumagalli and Motta (The Economic Journal, 2008) argued that competition among downstream buyers limits the ability of a dominant upstream firm to deter entry by a more efficient competitor. This comment demonstrates that the impact of downstream competition is, in fact, more complex. In particular, competition can motivate buyers to favour the incumbent due to a ‘raising rivals’ cost’ effect.
articles.abstract_cn: Fumagalli和Motta（《经济杂志》，2008）认为，下游买方之间的竞争限制了主导上游企业阻止更高效竞争者进入的能力。本评论表明，下游竞争的影响实际上更为复杂。特别是，竞争可能因“提高竞争对手成本”效应而促使买方偏向现有企业。
